class TestComputeTopologyUpdates:
    """Tests for compute_topology_updates helper."""

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_disjoint_neighbors(self):
        """Removed has neighbor Y (not in surviving's neighbors) -> remove Y->removed, add Y->surviving, add surviving->Y."""
        updates = compute_topology_updates(
            surviving_id="S",
            removed_id="R",
            surviving_neighbor_ids=["R", "X"],
            removed_neighbor_ids=["S", "Y"],
        )
        actions = [(u.context_id, u.action, u.target_id) for u in updates]

        # Y should have remove_neighbor for R
        assert any(
            u.context_id == "Y" and u.target_id == "R" and u.action == TopologyAction.remove_neighbor
            for u in updates
        ), "Neighbor Y must get remove_neighbor for removed context R"

        # Y should get add_neighbor for S (since Y was not in S's neighbors)
        assert any(
            u.context_id == "Y" and u.target_id == "S" and u.action == TopologyAction.add_neighbor
            for u in updates
        ), "Neighbor Y must get add_neighbor for surviving context S"

        # S should get add_neighbor for Y
        assert any(
            u.context_id == "S" and u.target_id == "Y" and u.action == TopologyAction.add_neighbor
            for u in updates
        ), "Surviving S must get add_neighbor for new neighbor Y"

        # S should get remove_neighbor for R
        assert any(
            u.context_id == "S" and u.target_id == "R" and u.action == TopologyAction.remove_neighbor
            for u in updates
        ), "Surviving S must get remove_neighbor for removed R"

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_overlapping_neighbors(self):
        """Shared neighbor X already knows surviving -> only remove, no add."""
        updates = compute_topology_updates(
            surviving_id="S",
            removed_id="R",
            surviving_neighbor_ids=["R", "X"],
            removed_neighbor_ids=["S", "X"],
        )
        # X gets remove_neighbor for R
        assert any(
            u.context_id == "X" and u.target_id == "R" and u.action == TopologyAction.remove_neighbor
            for u in updates
        ), "Shared neighbor X must get remove_neighbor for R"

        # X should NOT get add_neighbor for S (already a neighbor)
        assert not any(
            u.context_id == "X" and u.target_id == "S" and u.action == TopologyAction.add_neighbor
            for u in updates
        ), "Shared neighbor X must NOT get add_neighbor for S (already connected)"

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_empty_removed_neighbors_except_surviving(self):
        """Removed context only has surviving as neighbor -> minimal updates."""
        updates = compute_topology_updates(
            surviving_id="S",
            removed_id="R",
            surviving_neighbor_ids=["R", "X"],
            removed_neighbor_ids=["S"],
        )
        # S should get remove_neighbor for R
        assert any(
            u.context_id == "S" and u.target_id == "R" and u.action == TopologyAction.remove_neighbor
            for u in updates
        ), "Surviving S must get remove_neighbor for R"

        # No add_neighbor commands for external neighbors (there are none)

                surviving_neighbor_ids=[],
                removed_neighbor_ids=[],
            )

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_self_consistent_invariant(self):
        """Every external removed-neighbor gets a remove, and non-overlapping ones get add pairs."""
        updates = compute_topology_updates(
            surviving_id="S",
            removed_id="R",
            surviving_neighbor_ids=["R", "X"],
            removed_neighbor_ids=["S", "X", "Y", "Z"],

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_input_immutability(self):
        """Input contexts must not be mutated by merge."""
        config = make_system_config(max_energy=100.0)
        ctx_a = make_context(
            id="ctx-a", energy=10.0,
            agents=[make_agent("alice", "engineer")],
            vector_store=make_vector_store("vs-a", ["s1"]),
            neighbor_ids=["ctx-b"],
        )
        ctx_b = make_context(
            id="ctx-b", energy=7.0,
            agents=[make_agent("bob", "designer")],
            vector_store=make_vector_store("vs-b", ["s2"]),
            neighbor_ids=["ctx-a"],
        )
        # Capture state before
        a_id_before = ctx_a.id
        a_energy_before = ctx_a.energy
        a_agents_count_before = len(ctx_a.agents)
        a_signals_before = list(ctx_a.vector_store.signal_ids)
        a_neighbors_before = list(ctx_a.neighbor_ids)

        b_id_before = ctx_b.id
        b_energy_before = ctx_b.energy
        b_agents_count_before = len(ctx_b.agents)
        b_signals_before = list(ctx_b.vector_store.signal_ids)
        b_neighbors_before = list(ctx_b.neighbor_ids)

        await merge(ctx_a, ctx_b, system_config=config)

        # Verify nothing changed
        assert ctx_a.id == a_id_before
        assert ctx_a.energy == a_energy_before
        assert len(ctx_a.agents) == a_agents_count_before
        assert list(ctx_a.vector_store.signal_ids) == a_signals_before
        assert list(ctx_a.neighbor_ids) == a_neighbors_before

        assert ctx_b.id == b_id_before
        assert ctx_b.energy == b_energy_before
        assert len(ctx_b.agents) == b_agents_count_before
        assert list(ctx_b.vector_store.signal_ids) == b_signals_before
        assert list(ctx_b.neighbor_ids) == b_neighbors_before

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_topology_updates_completeness(self):
        """Every affected neighbor of the removed context receives appropriate topology update commands."""
        config = make_system_config(max_energy=100.0)
        # ctx-a (surviving, higher energy) neighbors: [ctx-b, ctx-x]
        # ctx-b (removed) neighbors: [ctx-a, ctx-y, ctx-z]
        ctx_a = make_context(
            id="ctx-a", energy=10.0,
            neighbor_ids=["ctx-b", "ctx-x"],
        )
        ctx_b = make_context(
            id="ctx-b", energy=3.0,
            neighbor_ids=["ctx-a", "ctx-y", "ctx-z"],
        )
        result = await merge(ctx_a, ctx_b, system_config=config)

        updates = result.topology_updates

        # ctx-y and ctx-z were neighbors of removed ctx-b but NOT of surviving ctx-a
        for neighbor in ["ctx-y", "ctx-z"]:
            # Must have remove_neighbor for ctx-b
            assert any(
                u.context_id == neighbor and u.target_id == "ctx-b" and u.action == TopologyAction.remove_neighbor
                for u in updates
            ), f"{neighbor} must get remove_neighbor for ctx-b"

            # Must have add_neighbor for ctx-a (they weren't previously connected)
            assert any(
                u.context_id == neighbor and u.target_id == "ctx-a" and u.action == TopologyAction.add_neighbor
                for u in updates
            ), f"{neighbor} must get add_neighbor for ctx-a"

        # ctx-a must get remove_neighbor for ctx-b
        assert any(
            u.context_id == "ctx-a" and u.target_id == "ctx-b" and u.action == TopologyAction.remove_neighbor
            for u in updates
        ), "Surviving ctx-a must get remove_neighbor for ctx-b"

    async def test_merge_with_many_agents_dedup(self):
        """Complex agent dedup scenario with many overlapping agents."""
        config = make_system_config(max_energy=100.0)
        agents_a = [
            make_agent("alice", "engineer", {"ver": "a"}),
            make_agent("bob", "designer", {"ver": "a"}),
            make_agent("carol", "manager", {"ver": "a"}),
        ]
        agents_b = [
            make_agent("alice", "engineer", {"ver": "b"}),

            make_agent("carol", "manager", {"ver": "b"}),
        ]

        result = await merge(ctx_a, ctx_b, system_config=config)

        merged_agents = result.merged_context.agents
        keys = {(a.identity, a.role) for a in merged_agents}
        assert keys == {
            ("alice", "engineer"),
            ("bob", "designer"),
            ("carol", "manager"),
            ("dave", "tester"),
        }, "All unique agent keys must be present"
        assert len(merged_agents) == 4, "4 unique agents after dedup"

        # Conflicting agents should come from preferred (ctx-a, higher energy)
        alice = [a for a in merged_agents if a.identity == "alice"][0]
